assumptions.physical_size_source: User reported 25cm white / 38cm gray; nominal stud counts remain visual hypotheses
assumptions.tape_inset_interpretation: Approximate 16mm per covered edge from 2 rows x 8mm pitch; tape inner-edge position within row gap unknown
assumptions.observed_quad_semantics: X edges are full unmasked side edges; Y edges are tape inner edges bounding uncovered region, not full outer plate

pixel_pick_uncertainty.scenarios: Two fixed sensitivities: white uncovered quad expanded/contracted 3px on each axis about its center. Other pixel anchors and assumed 16mm tape insets remain fixed; not statistical or worst-case bounds.

limitations: User-reported white 250mm outer width sets scale; Y calibration uses 218mm uncovered span after two 16mm insets. Gray 380mm outer width is an independent check.
Native 32/48 stud footprints at 8mm pitch are 256/384mm, differing 6/4mm from user-reported widths. No native geometry or stud pitch is stretched to fit.

Black tape conceals full outer Y edges; recorded quads are uncovered bounds. Hidden outer bounds are inferred with approximate 16mm insets, not directly observed. Ruler 0/20 marks remain independent manual checks.
One plane approximates tabletop and raised plates; no lens distortion or phone intrinsics are inferred.
Base foot is occluded; its approximate image center is not a calibrated FR3 frame or yaw. Bowl rim is above the table and not its measured contact footprint.
Homography reprojection error cannot establish physical accuracy. Two perturbations omit independent point-pick, height/parallax, lens and dimension errors.
